1–2 hours (freeing) + as long as you like putting out fires

In Shadowthorn, the elves who refused to worship the bog god set fire to the village and were locked up in three underground prisons. If you kill the guards and all the elves, the prisons open and, the next day, Shadowthorn is on fire. You put out the fires with swamp water from the bog god's temple: 500 fires give the achievement **Firefighter** and, with luck, a Thornfire Wolf appears that you can turn into the {item:Crystal Wolf (Mount)|Crystal Wolf} mount.

When the bog god appeared in Shadowthorn, there was conflict between his followers and those who did not want to follow him. The latter rebelled and set the village on fire. After they were contained the village became safe, but only for as long as they cannot break free.

With Shadowthorn on fire, each fire you put out has a small chance of making a {creature:Thornfire Wolf} appear: lure it to the {item:Bog Water} at the bog god's temple to turn it into a {creature:Crystal Wolf} and tame it with the {item:Diapason}.
To find out what stage Shadowthorn is in, ask {npc:Pyro Peter} in Venore about {key:Shadowthorn}, or ask any {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC} about {key:thornfire}.
Make several {item:Prepared Bucket|Prepared Buckets} at once: each bucket only puts out one fire before you have to fill it again.
If you want the mount, **do not kill** the Thornfire Wolves and bring a {item:Diapason}.

Go to **Venore** and talk to {npc:Pyro Peter}, who wanders around the marked area. Say {key:hi} and {key:Shadowthorn} to find out whether the firestarters are locked up or the village is on fire. Alternatively, ask a Guide NPC about {key:thornfire}.

Do this part when Shadowthorn is **not** on fire. The firestarters are in three underground prisons, each guarded by an {creature:Elf Overseer}. The wooden bars are covered in moss by the bog god's magic.

Leave **Venore** through the city's **east exit** and cross the swamp **southeast** to the elf camp, {wiki:Shadowthorn}. The map shows the fastest route (there are others). A {item:Machete} and a {item:Shovel} are not required, but they help you cross the swamp.
Fastest route from Venore to Shadowthorn
On the way there are {creature:Snake|Snakes} and maybe {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Centipede|Centipedes} and {creature:Slime|Slimes}.
Go to the entrance of {wiki:Shadowthorn} (blue flag on the map). Go **east** straight away and go down the tower stairs. The three prisons are marked with red Xs on the map.
Shadowthorn map: entrance (blue flag), three prisons (red Xs) and bog god temple (cross)
Kill **all three** {creature:Elf Overseer|Elf Overseers}, one in each prison. They only reappear the next time Shadowthorn stops burning.

Kill **all the elves** of Shadowthorn at least once ({creature:Elf|Elves}, {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts}, etc.). They respawn, but you only need to kill each one once. As the followers die, the bog god's power weakens and the moss on the bars disappears.
You have to kill **absolutely all** the elves, otherwise the moss does not come off the bars.

When the moss disappears, break the {item:Wooden Bars} of the three prisons with any weapon to free the {creature:Firestarter|Firestarters}. The bars re-form and can be broken again; what matters is that the moss is gone. Then go up the tower stairs you came down to return to the village surface.
The next day (after Server Save) Shadowthorn will be in flames
When the firestarters escape, they set the village on fire. The flames are magical: only water from the swamp at the bog god's temple puts them out.
Use a {item:Flask of Embalming Fluid} on a normal {item:Bucket} to make a {item:Prepared Bucket}. A normal bucket cannot hold the swamp's slippery water. Make several at once.
Check the Market: sometimes Prepared Buckets are cheaper than buying the Embalming Fluid.
Go to the bog god's temple, **east** of the Shadowthorn entrance (cross on the map). Use the {item:Prepared Bucket} on the {item:Bog Water} to get a {item:Bucket of Bog Water}.
When you step on the water this appears: *"The water of the bog seems slippery and tries to escape even your clothes."*

Walk around Shadowthorn and use the {item:Bucket of Bog Water} on the flames. After each use you have to refill the bucket. When you put out **500 thornfires** you earn the achievement **Firefighter**.

Every time you put out a fire there is a **small** chance (0.1–1%) of a {creature:Thornfire Wolf} appearing. Wherever the fire is, the wolf always appears **west of the lake**. An orange message appears across the village: *"Unleash the flaming wolves and burn the house of the enemy!"*
Thornfire Wolf spawn (west of the lake)

**Do not kill** the Thornfire Wolf. Lure it to the bog god's temple: as soon as it steps on the {item:Bog Water}, it turns into a {creature:Crystal Wolf}. Use the {item:Diapason} on the Crystal Wolf to tame it.

If you want to kill both wolves for the {wiki:Bestiary}: hit the Thornfire Wolf with weak attacks until it has red health, lure it into the water and, the instant the Crystal Wolf appears, land the final blow on the Thornfire Wolf. The Thornfire Wolf counts for the Bestiary and the Crystal Wolf appears anyway, so you can kill both.
Use an attack rune or spell for the final blow: melee attacks may be delayed.
When you are done (fires and, if you want, the mount), go back the same way: leave Shadowthorn and cross the swamp **northwest** to the east exit of **Venore**.
After enough fires have been put out, the firestarters are locked up again and the village goes back to normal at the next Server Save.
The fire is reset twice a day, 8 and 16 hours after Server Save, to give other players the chance to put out fires and face the creatures exclusive to this World Change.
This World Change was introduced in the Summer Update 2011.
